guide.title: Me pēhea te whakamahi i LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Kōwhiria a Windows, a Android rānei, whai i ngā hipanga paepae, tīmatahia te whakamātautau, kātahi whakamutua, pānuihia hoki te pūrongo.
guide.mockBody: He pūrere whakaatu ā-roto te Pūrere Ā-rohe Tōrire. Ka whakaputa ōna ūnga i ngā inenga tōrire kua tino tohua hei mock, kia ako ai koe i te rere mahi me te kore hono pūmārō.
guide.pcBody: Ka whakarārangi te PC ā-rohe i ngā tukanga Windows tūturu. Kōwhiria kotahi te ūnga tukanga hei kohi CPU me te mahara. Me mārama te hopu PresentMon mō te FPS.
guide.androidBody: I te waea, whakahohea ngā kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake me te USB debugging, whakamanahia tēnei PC, huakina te taupānga hei whakamātau, kātahi kōwhiria i konei, tīmatahia he wāhanga.
guide.deviceConcept: Pūrere: te pūtake hei kohi raraunga, pērā i tēnei PC, i tētahi waea Android rānei.
guide.targetConcept: Ūnga: te taupānga, te kēmu, te tukanga rānei e hiahia ana koe ki te ine i taua pūrere.
guide.sessionConcept: Wāhanga: kotahi te whakahaerenga inenga. Tīmatahia, mātakihia ngā inenga, whakamutua, kātahi huakina te pūrongo.
support.title: Whakatika / Tukuna hapa
support.body: Whakamātauria te tīmata anō haumaru me te taki anō i ngā utauta. Ki te mau tonu te raruraru, huakina te puka hapa GitHub kua rite.
support.repairDescription: Tīmata anō te kohinga ā-rohe, ka taki anō i ngā pūrere me ngā utauta.
support.repairingHelp: E tīmata anō ana i te kohinga ā-rohe, e taki anō ana i ngā utauta me ngā pūrere.
support.repairSuccess: Kua oti te whakatika. Kua whakahoungia te tūnga o ngā utauta me ngā pūrere.
support.repairFailed: Kāore i oti te whakatika aunoa. Ka taea te tuku hapa hei whai atu.
support.submitDescription: Huakina te puka hapa GitHub kua rite mā te pāwhiri kotahi.
support.submitFailed: Kāore i taea te huaki i te whārangi hapa GitHub.
support.include: Ngā taipitopito whai hua: putanga taupānga, putanga Windows/Android, tauira pūrere, te mea i pāwhiria, te mea i tūmanakohia, te mea i puta, ngā hopu mata me te kaweake tātaritanga kua purea.
support.privacy: Kaua e whakauru i ngā tohu, pūkete, ara ā-rohe katoa, rangitaki mata, kōnae CSV mata, logcat, bugreport, hopu mata tūmataiti rānei.
device.mockDescription: Raraunga akoranga haumaru. He raraunga hanga ngā inenga, ā, kua tino tohua hei mock.
device.localPcDescription: Te rapu tukanga Windows tūturu me te whakatauira CPU/mahara.
session.beginnerTitle: Te whakahaerenga tuatahi e taunakitia ana
session.beginnerBody: Mō tō whakamātautau tuatahi, kōwhiria a Windows, kōwhiria he tukanga taupānga e rere ana, pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau, whakamutua i muri i ētahi hēkona, kātahi huakina te pūrongo.
session.platformSubtitle: Tīmata i te paepae e hiahia ana koe ki te whakamātau. Mā LumaTrace koe e ārahi ki te hipanga e whai ake nei, ā, ka waiho ngā inenga kāore i te wātea hei N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Kōwhiria he tukanga taupānga, kēmu rānei i tēnei PC, kātahi tīmatahia te whakamātau. Ki te mutu te tukanga, ka mutu te wāhanga, ka tuhi rānei i tētahi aukatinga mārama.
session.platformAndroidBody: Whakahohea ngā kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake me te USB debugging i te waea, whakamanahia tēnei PC, huakina te taupānga hei whakamātau, kātahi pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau. Ka rapu aunoa a LumaTrace i te mōkī kei mua.
session.targetHelp: Kua rite ngā tautuhinga taunoa haumaru.
session.runningHelp: Whakamahia te taupānga i runga i te tikanga noa. Whakamutua te whakamātautau ina hopukina te āhuatanga e hiahia ana koe ki te ine.
session.nextSteps: Ngā hipanga e whai ake nei
session.defaultStep1: Kōwhiria a Windows, a Android rānei.
session.defaultStep2: Whāia te tohutohu hononga, kōwhiringa taupānga rānei e hāngai ana ki te paepae.
session.defaultStep3: Tīmatahia te whakamātautau i muri i te kōwhiri pūrere me te ūnga.
session.choosePlatformFirstTitle: Kōwhiria he paepae kia haere tonu
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: I muri i te kōwhiri i a Windows, i a Android rānei, ka whakaatu tēnei wāhi i te pūrere, te ūnga me te mahi tīmata mō taua paepae anake.
session.windowsStep2: Kōwhiria te tukanga taupānga mai i te Ūnga.
session.windowsStep3: Pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau. Ka whakahou ora te CPU, mahara, FPS me te wā tāpare ina wātea a PresentMon; ki te kore, ka noho te FPS hei N/A.
session.androidStep1: I te waea Android, whakahohea ngā kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake, whakakāngia te USB debugging, honoa te taura USB, whakamanahia hoki tēnei PC.
session.androidStep2: Huakina te taupānga hei whakamātau i te waea.
session.androidStep3: Pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau. Ka rapu aunoa a LumaTrace i te mōkī taupānga kei mua i te waea.
session.mockHint: Mō te ako i te rere mahi anake ngā ūnga tōrire. Ehara ēnei i ngā inenga pūrere, taupānga tūturu rānei.
session.noPlatformDevice: Kāore anō he pūrere mō tēnei paepae.
session.noTargetSelected: Kōwhiria he ūnga i mua i te tīmata.
session.androidForegroundTitle: Te taupānga o nāianei i te waea
session.androidForegroundPending: Huakina te taupānga i te waea, kātahi pāwhiria Tīmata whakamātautau. Ka puta te ingoa mōkī ki konei i muri i te rapunga.
session.targetSearchPlaceholder: Patohia he ingoa, hei tauira java.exe
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Ka whakaaturia ngā taupānga tuwhera i te tuatahi. Ka kitea hoki e te rapunga ngā tukanga papamuri.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Kāore he tukanga Windows e ōrite ana ki tēnei rapunga. Whakamātauria he ingoa kē, whakahoungia rānei ngā ūnga.
session.exportLogsToReportDir: Penapenahia te rangitaki ki te kōpaki pūrongo
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Ka penapena a Android i tētahi ADB logcat kua purea mō te wā whakamātautau. Ka penapena a Windows i ngā pūkete wāhanga LumaTrace whai waitohu-wā.
session.endingTest: E whakamutu ana i te whakamātautau...
session.openReportAfterStop: Huakina te pūrongo mō tēnei whakahaerenga
session.noWindowsTargets: Kāore anō kia kitea he tukanga taupānga Windows e rere ana. Huakina te taupānga, te kēmu rānei hei whakamātau, kātahi whakahoungia te rārangi ūnga.
session.noAndroidTargets: Kāore anō he ūnga taupānga Android e wātea ana. Whakahohea ngā kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake me te USB debugging, whakamanahia tēnei PC, huakina te taupānga i te waea, kātahi whakahoungia.
device.title: Ngā taipitopito pūrere
device.subtitle: Ngā ūnga me te wāteatanga inenga mō te pūrere tūmau ā-rohe kua kōwhiria.
device.androidHelp: Me whai kōwhiringa Kaiwhakawhanake me te whakamana USB debugging a Android Beta. Ka tautoko i ngā mana huringa-ora Tīmata Taupānga / Whakamutua Taupānga, ngā tātaritanga here-anō tukanga, me te tūnga keteroki/hauora kua purea. Me whai adb mō te whakatauira CPU, mahara, pūhiko me te whatunga. He whakamātau tonu te FPS.
device.pcHelp: Ka whakarārangi a PC Beta i ngā tukanga Windows ā-rohe, ā, ka taea te whakatauira CPU me te mahara kua herea ki te PID. Me whai PresentMon te FPS me te wā tāpare, ā, he whakamātau tonu; ka hunaia ngā ara kōnae whakahaere i mua i te whakaatu.
device.loadingTargets: E uta ana i ngā ūnga...
device.forceStopConfirm: Ka whakamutu ā-kaha tēnei i te mōkī ūnga i te pūrere.

device.loadingCapabilities: E uta ana i ngā āheinga...
session.title: Wāhanga whakamātautau
session.subtitle: Kōwhiria he paepae, kōwhiria te taupānga, tukanga ūnga rānei, tīmatahia te kohinga, kātahi whakamutua, pānuihia hoki te pūrongo.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Tērā pea ka uru te hokohoko o ētahi atu taupānga ki ngā tatauranga whatunga taumata-pūrere.
session.uidNetworkNotice: Ka whakatau tatahia ngā tatauranga whatunga taumata-UID mai i ngā taipitopito dumpsys netstats.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Ka whakamahi te whatunga Android i ngā netstats taumata-UID ina wātea, ā, ka hoki ki ngā tatauranga taumata-pūrere me te tika kua whakamāramatia.
session.androidFpsNotice: He whakamātau te FPS/wā tāpare Android, ā, ka whakamātauria i te wā whakamātautau mā ngā tatauranga tāpare ADB tūmatanui. Ki te kore a Android e tuku raraunga tāpare ōrite, ka noho hei N/A.
session.pcNotice: Ka whakamātau aunoa ngā whakamātautau Windows i te FPS/wā tāpare PresentMon wā-tūturu ina wātea a PresentMon. Ka mahi tonu te CPU me te mahara ki te ngaro a PresentMon. Wāteatanga PresentMon: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Ka kohi auau ake ngā tau iti, ka ora ake hoki ngā ānau, engari ka nui ake te CPU. He māmā ake ngā tau nui, he pai mō ngā whakamātautau roa, engari he iti ake ngā taipitopito o te ānau. He tautuhinga taunoa pai te 100 ms.
session.settingReportOutputDir: E tautuhi ana i te kōpaki...
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Kōwhiria te wāhi penapena i ngā pūrongo whakamātautau. Ka mutu te whakamātautau, ka tuhi a LumaTrace i ngā pūrongo HTML, JSON me CSV ki tēnei kōpaki.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Ka wātea ina pūrongohia e te tūmau ā-rohe tētahi kōpaki.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: Kua whakahoungia te kōpaki pūrongo. Kua tīmata anō te tūmau ā-rohe i runga i te haumaru.
session.reportOutputDirChangeFailed: Kāore i taea te tautuhi kōpaki pūrongo.
session.reportOutputDirOpenFailed: Kāore i taea te huaki kōpaki pūrongo.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Ka whakamahi ngā tautuhinga whakamātautau katoa i ngā taunoa haumaru. Ka noho ngā inenga ngaro hei N/A, ā, e kore rawa e whakakīia ki te 0.
session.autoStart: Tīmata aunoa i te taupānga ūnga
session.autoStartHelp: Tīmata Taupānga i mua i te wāhanga ina ngaro te PID
session.monkeyFallback: Whakaaetia te monkey hei huarahi kē
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Whakamahia monkey -p package 1 ina rahua anake te rapu pūwhakarewa
session.stopTarget: Whakamutua te ūnga ina mutu te wāhanga
session.stopTargetHelp: Whakamutu ā-kaha i te mōkī ūnga i muri i te mutu o te wāhanga
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Whakahohea te pūrapu FPS whakamātau i te wā whakamutu
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Whakahaerehia he hopu CSV whai wā mō te FPS/wā tāpare
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Pupuritia te CSV rangitahi tae noa ki te horoi wāhanga mō te patuiro ā-rohe
session.androidFpsNaNotice: Ka noho te FPS me te wā tāpare hei N/A ki te kore te pūrapu whakamātau e whakaputa inenga e ōrite ana ki te ūnga. E kore ngā paparanga rangirua, ngaro rānei e hurihia hei FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: Kāore a LumaTrace e tīmata, e whakamutu rānei i te tukanga kua kōwhiria. He whakamātau te hopu PresentMon. Ki te kore he rārangi PresentMon ōrite, ka noho te FPS hei N/A.
session.autoStopped: I mutu te taupānga ūnga, nō reira i oti aunoa te whakamātautau, ā, i penapenahia tōna pūrongo wāhanga.
session.restoreMissing: Kāore i taea e te tūmau ā-rohe te whakaū i te wāhanga whakamutunga.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: E hono ana ki te ūnga, e tatari ana hoki ki ngā inenga tūturu tuatahi. Ka puta aunoa ngā tūtohi ina tae mai he raraunga.
session.stopDialogMessage: Mā te whakamutu e tuku ngā inenga, e hanga pūrongo hoki. E kore e muku i te hītori ā-rohe.
session.createDialogMessage: Kei te rere kē tētahi wāhanga. Whakamutua i mua i te whakawhiti wāhanga kia mārama tonu te kohinga.
report.title: Ngā hua whakamātautau
report.subtitle: Kōwhiria he hua whakamātautau kia kite i te FPS, 1% Low, wā tāpare, CPU, mahara me ngā pūrongo kua kaweake.
report.deleteOneMessage: Mukua a {name} me ōna raraunga ā-rohe kua kohia? Ka puritia ngā kōnae pūrongo kua kaweake.
report.deleteAllMessage: Mukua ngā hua whakamātautau ā-rohe {count} kua oti me ā rātou raraunga kua kohia? Ka puritia ngā whakamātautau e rere ana me ngā kōnae pūrongo kua kaweake.
report.recentResultsHelp: Kōwhiria he whakamātautau kua oti, kua haukotia rānei kia kite i tōna pūrongo.
report.loadingSessions: E uta ana i ngā hua whakamātautau...
report.noResultsMessage: Whakahaerehia tuatahitia he whakamātautau Windows, Android rānei. Ka puta te pūrongo ki konei i muri i te whakamutu.
report.emptyEyebrow: Kua rite mō tō hua tuatahi

report.performanceGroupHelp: Tīmata i konei: ka whakaatu te FPS i te māeneene, ā, ka whakaatu te 1% Low me te wā tāpare i te pūmautanga.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: CPU, GPU me te mahara i whakamahia i te whakamātautau i tēnei taupānga, tukanga rānei.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Raraunga hiko, pāmahana GPU, pūhiko me te whatunga i kohia e te paepae.
report.performancePoor: Ko te FPS toharite he {avg}, kei raro i te 30 FPS. He ngoikore te mahinga, ā, tērā pea ka kitea te hārakiraki.
report.performanceFair: Ko te FPS toharite he {avg}, kei waenga i te 30 me te 59.9 FPS. He manakohia te mahinga, engari tērā pea kāore ngā tirohanga uaua e tino māeneene.
report.performanceGood: Ko te FPS toharite he {avg}, he 60 FPS, neke atu rānei. He pai te mahinga, ā, me māeneene te wheako i te nuinga.
report.performanceUnavailable: Kāore i kohia te FPS toharite, nō reira kāore tēnei pūrongo e taea te aromatawai i te mahinga tāhuahua.
report.stabilityGood: Ko te 1% Low he {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% o te toharite), e tohu ana i te tuku tāpare pūmau i te nuinga.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: Ko te 1% Low he {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% o te toharite), e tohu ana i ngā rerekētanga kitea o te auau tāpare.
report.stabilityUnavailable: Kāore i rawaka ngā raraunga 1% Low hei aromatawai i te pūmautanga auau tāpare.
report.performanceThresholdNote: He aratohu whānui ēnei pae FPS. Ka taea e te tepe auau tāpare ūnga, te auau tāmata mata, ngā tautuhinga ā-kanohi me te āhuatanga whakamātautau te whakarerekē i te tikanga.
report.rawPreview: Ka whakamahi ngā pūrongo poto i ngā tauira inenga mata mō te arokite tūtohi.
report.downsampledPreview: Ka whakamahi ngā pūrongo roa i ngā toharite kete mō te arokite tūtohi. Ka noho ngā kaweake mata kāore i panoni.
report.noTrendDataMessage: Ka noho ngā tūtohi FPS, wā tāpare, CPU me te mahara hei N/A ina kāore he tauira tau e wātea ana.
report.exportHelp: I roa tēnei whakamātautau mō te {duration}. E wātea ana ngā tauira inenga mata {metrics} hei kaweake.
report.loading: E uta ana i te pūrongo...
report.noPresentMonMessage: Ka noho te FPS me te wā tāpare hei N/A ina monokia te hopu, ngaro, kore ōrite, rangirua rānei.
report.presentMonNotice: He mārama, he whakamātau hoki te hopu PresentMon. Kāore ngā pūrongo e whakauru i te ihirangi CSV mata, i ngā ara putanga ā-rohe katoa rānei.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Kua purea ngā kaweake, ā, kāore e whakauru i te putanga logcat, bugreport rānei.

packaging.check9: Kāore anō kia whirihorahia te waitohu whakaputanga, pūwhakahou, manatoko me te tohatoha toa.
packaging.rcNotice: Ka whakakotahi tēnei whakarāpopoto i te rite sidecar, QA GUI ā-ringa, kaupapahere putanga me ngā taunakitanga kūwaha RC ki tētahi tirohanga kua purea. Ehara tēnei i te whakaaetanga putanga, ā, ka noho te productionReady hei false.

presentMon.permissionsBody: Me uru kotahi te FPS wā-tūturu ki te takahinga mahinga Windows. Ka rere tonu a LumaTrace me te kore mana kaiwhakahaere, ā, ka wātea tonu te CPU/mahara me te kore uru FPS.
session.fpsAccessBody: Ka mahi te CPU me te mahara ināianei. Whakahohea te takahinga mahinga Windows kotahi te wā kia tāpiri i te FPS me te wā tāpare.
session.fpsAccessEnabling: E tatari ana ki a Windows...
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Waitohua atu i a Windows, kātahi waitohua mai anō kotahi te wā. Ka rere ngā whakamātautau ā muri ake me te kore uru kaiwhakahaere.
session.fpsAccessErrorTitle: I rahua te taki uru FPS
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: Kei te wātea tonu te CPU me te mahara. Whakamātauria te taki anō.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Kāore he mea i panoni. Haere tonu me te CPU me te mahara, whakahohea rānei te FPS ā muri ake.
presentMon.retentionBody: Kāore rawa ngā pūrongo e whakauru i te ihirangi CSV mata PresentMon. Ka purea ngā ara ā-rohe i mua i te putanga ki ngā tātaritanga, pūrongo rānei.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Hangaia, tīmatahia rānei he whakamātautau Windows kia kite i te tūnga hopu.
presentMon.defaultReason: He mārama, he whakamātau hoki te hopu PresentMon. Ka tukuna te FPS i muri anake i te whakataurite ūnga angitu.
pc.sourcePrecision: Ka ahu mai te FPS Windows me te wā tāpare i te hopu CSV PresentMon mārama, ā, he whakamātau tonu. Ka haere tonu te CPU me te mahara ina ngaro a PresentMon, ina kore rānei he raraunga.
